scopes.battle-core: All original game_battle.js definition/global records, observed source helpers, and conservative static ed/global reference closure
scopes.battle: All game_battle/game_util/game_base records and conservative static reference closure
scopes.observed: Compiler plumbing only: source factory keys accessed by the exact reference execution; not broad-domain qualification
scopes.all: All copied-source definition/global records; may exceed native compiler memory

missingScopePolicy: All original known property/global names remain registered; reading an omitted factory throws unsupported rather than returning undefined
runtimeCode: Original RHS expressions are emitted as statically compiled factories; original global FunctionDeclaration statements are emitted unchanged before initializers; no runtime eval or Function constructor is introduced
boot: The copied source oracle's exact sourceRecords initializers/postInitializers are emitted in the same phases, including computed writes, descriptors and protection wrappers
tableIO: Decoded source JSON via external hermescli.loadFile by default; --embed-tables embeds a JSON string instead of a huge object AST; missing accessed tables throw
hostInputs: Record real copied-oracle Math.random and kind-tagged Date observations; replay exact tapes in emitted Node/native; original ed.rand/srand are unchanged
stopwatch: Harness captures native Date.now before source clock instrumentation; stopwatch observations never consume game clock inputs
callbacks: Original queue/reset functions, captured FIFO drain and original snapshot method; queued callbacks execute after source engine.update with clear-before-update ordering
comparison: Persisted JSON results include original battle outcome/ticks, callback counts, raw binary64 state/RNG fields and complete host device output; emitted Node must match copied source before native qualification
metadata: Per-record original-source SHA256, all boot/declaration records, Cocos/host/clock/realm/loader/scenario/emitter helper hashes, table/input digests and generated-file digest are emitted beside the ignored generated program
qualification: No throughput or full-domain fidelity claim is implied by emission, one matching case, or an observed-only build
